when: 2026-08-12, the day after the balance slice landed and the day the owner played it
what: How much of the domain takes the field when a wave lands, measured on the tree before the balance slice and on the tree after it, over every shipped journal and the whole seed matrix. This is criterion 1 of Issue #405 — the number that says whether «не все бегут защищаться» is new.

theSentenceBeingChecked.said: «Ещё когда начинается атака не все бегут защищаться - возможно так и задумано, но это новое»
twoClaimsInIt: «не все» — a share, measured below per wave and per party
«это новое» — a comparison, measured below against 3b627bf, the parent of the slice

tree.measuredAt: 37bf0ad, the commit that adds the instrument
tree.beforeTree: 3b627bf — the parent of 8977b0d, checked out into a throwaway worktree with the instrument file copied in and nothing else changed

howItWasMeasured.harness: tests/DungeonFortress.Simulation.Tests/PrototypeMusterParticipationTests.cs, added by this branch. It reads the canonical event log and GetSnapshot() only.
howItWasMeasured.commandForBefore: git worktree add --detach ../_wt-405-before 8977b0d^ ; cp tests/DungeonFortress.Simulation.Tests/PrototypeMusterParticipationTests.cs ../_wt-405-before/tests/DungeonFortress.Simulation.Tests/ ; (cd ../_wt-405-before && dotnet test tests/DungeonFortress.Simulation.Tests -c Release --filter "FullyQualifiedName~Report_muster_participation" --logger "console;verbosity=detailed")
howItWasMeasured.whyTheSameFileRunsOnBothTrees: It names no constant the slice renamed. The admission threshold is read out of the journal entry that carries it (`details.threshold` of combat_refused_starving), not out of PrototypeTuning, where it is CombatMinSatiety before the slice and CombatJoinSatiety after it.
howItWasMeasured.repeatability: The report was taken twice in a row on the after tree and the two outputs are byte-identical, sha256 7f52ecc299ace5e84c3c35abecc9c6e65f01664552d3b42bfa819090475f89e9. That is the checkpoint-1 property: the instrument re-takes the number with one command and gives the same number.
howItWasMeasured.coverage: 12 parties — the three shipped journals (baseline, prepared, neglected) on four seeds: the matrix 20260726..20260728 plus 20260729, the seed the owner played.

whatIsCounted.denominator: onFeet — every creature whose mode is not Downed on the tick the wave arrives. A body on the floor is visibly out of the fight and is counted apart, in onTheFloor.
whatIsCounted.numerator: joined — creatures with a `combat_joined` entry carrying this wave's number, at any roll call of the wave. Joining late still counts as joining; lateness is reported separately as joinedLate.
whatIsCounted.share: joined * 100 / onFeet, integer, per wave; pooled over waves and not as a mean of means.
whatIsCounted.absentBy: the reason each absentee is absent for, taken from its LAST roll call of the wave — the refusal that still held when the wave ended. Counted once per creature per wave, not once per roll call.
whatIsCounted.whyTheJournalAndNotLastDecision: The refusal is decided in phase 4 and the same creature goes on to eat, take a job and move in the phases after it, so LastDecision no longer holds the refusal by the end of the tick. The journal does.

theAnswer.isItNew: BOTH, and the two halves must be said together or the answer misleads. Pooled over the whole matrix the share went UP after the slice — 84% before, 89% after — so the domain-wide muster did not get worse and «не все бегут» is not a new property of the game. On the party the owner actually played, baseline/20260729, it went DOWN — 94% before, 86% after, and on its third wave from 88% to 55%, four of nine standing aside. So what the owner saw IS new, on the seed he saw it on, and it is not a regression of the whole game.
theAnswer.whatCausedItOnHisSeed: The admission threshold, and nothing else in the slice. Named creatures, all of them in the satiety band 20..29 — above the old threshold of 20 and below the new one of 30: wave 3 #1 Кремень (satiety 25), #2 Мотылёк (27), #6 Прель (26); wave 4 #5 Уголёк (22). Rolling the threshold back to 20 on the after tree and changing nothing else puts exactly those four back in the line and the party back to 97% (evidence/405-mutant.json, M1).
theAnswer.isThatDesigned: Yes. See evidence/405-reasons.json for the decision behind each reason code.

pooled.whatMoved: Starving refusals rose 9 -> 12, which is the threshold. Injured refusals fell 23 -> 18 and unreachable fell 13 -> 1, which is the rest of the slice. The three together net to +14 creature-slots in the line.

theOwnersOwnParty.readingIt: Three of the four new absentees were first turned away as unreachable while still fed, and only then fell under the threshold — they were walking to the muster and went hungry on the way. That is why the wave the owner remembers is the third one and not the first.

theContractIndicator.what: Roll calls at which `combat_absent_unreachable` was written while a raider stood within T.engage_radius (8) of the creature it turned away, Manhattan.
theContractIndicator.whyItIsHere: Contract 10.2 admits a creature that is within the engage radius of the nearest RAIDER **or** of the nearest larder tile. UpdateCombatParticipation measures the distance to PrototypeMap.LarderTiles[0] and to nothing else, so a creature with a raider two tiles away and the larder twelve tiles away is turned away by the code and admitted by the contract.
theContractIndicator.worstSingleReading: baseline/20260729 t2020, the second roll call of wave 3: five creatures turned away as unreachable with raiders 2, 5, 5, 6 and 6 tiles from them — #0 Брусок at toRaider=2 while toLarder=12.
theContractIndicator.isItNew: No. The line is identical on both trees; the slice does not touch it. Pooled it bites LESS often after the slice, not more. It bites twice as often on the owner's own seed.
theContractIndicator.isItDesigned: No — the published contract says otherwise. This is the one finding of Issue #405 that is not «так задумано», and it is what this branch fixes.
theContractIndicator.approximations: Manhattan and not a walk, so a small reading does not prove a short walk; and it is read off the end-of-tick snapshot, one phase after the roll call, so the raider may have stepped since. Both are why the indicator is reported and never asserted on.
